test_runs.skip_reason: Optional real bubblewrap integration test requires KAI_RUN_SANDBOX_INTEGRATION=1.

test_runs.command: KAI_HOME=/tmp/kai-cli-smoke.vmiGnT PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m kai benchmark cpu-predictor

limitations: Repository inspection and unit tests are not equivalent to deployed end-to-end evidence.
The CPU replay benchmark uses fixed synthetic data and does not show predictor generalization.
No end-to-end income experiment or long-running daemon recovery test was performed.
assessment.operational_note: One pre-change benchmark CLI smoke was inadvertently run without a temporary KAI_HOME and appended BENCHMARK_COMPLETED event_id 7 to the configured KAI database. The append-only event was verified read-only and retained; no existing event was deleted. Subsequent CLI validation used a temporary KAI_HOME.

maturity_scale.0.0: Missing, unsafe, or contradicted by evidence.
maturity_scale.0.25: Documented or designed, but no demonstrated implementation.
maturity_scale.0.5: Implementation exists, but behavior has not been adequately verified.
maturity_scale.0.75: Relevant tests passed and capability is demonstrated within a defined scope.
maturity_scale.1.0: Reproducible end-to-end evidence demonstrates behavior, including failure paths, limitations, and regression checks.

criteria.description: Collect a structured OS/runtime/resource inventory with provenance and explicit unknowns.
criteria.limitation: Coverage is bounded to implemented host observations; it is not a continuous live monitor.

criteria.description: Separate hardware visibility, driver/runtime discovery, and operational usability.
criteria.limitation: Every discovered accelerator/runtime capability has not been operationally probed.

categories.name: Structured representation, epistemic verification, and persistent memory

criteria.description: Persist structured events, experiences, predictions, and memory with schema migration support.
criteria.limitation: Full retention, export, and disaster-recovery lifecycle evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Preserve provenance and OBSERVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN epistemic distinctions.
criteria.limitation: Independent reconciliation of contradictory external claims is not broadly demonstrated.

categories.name: Modeling, prediction, reasoning, and goal planning

criteria.description: Provide a deterministic predictor with explicit uncertainty and evaluation limits.
criteria.limitation: The predictor is narrow and has no demonstrated broad-task generalization.

criteria.description: Represent goals and validate constrained engineering plans before proposal execution.
criteria.limitation: There is no general-purpose autonomous planner or goal scheduler.

categories.name: Authorized action execution, tools, and task orchestration

criteria.description: Constrain candidate file operations and candidate test execution through the approved sandbox path.
criteria.limitation: No unrestricted action interface or production deployment is supported.

criteria.description: Persist bounded engineering task stages and validate model-generated plans.
criteria.limitation: Successful live end-to-end patch generation and candidate evaluation remain unverified.

categories.name: Measurable learning and general benchmark infrastructure

criteria.description: Link predictions, observations, evaluations, and model updates in persistent evidence.
criteria.limitation: Durable held-out generalization evidence is not established.

criteria.description: Use a versioned paired benchmark contract with raw cases, reusable registration, and tested decision states.
criteria.limitation: Only the synthetic CPU reference dataset is provided; no independent held-out benchmark is yet established.

criteria.description: Create bounded disposable candidates and audit modifications and sandboxed runs.
criteria.limitation: The complete live sandbox lifecycle is not an end-to-end production promotion path.

criteria.description: Gate candidate acceptance on validated evidence and preserve prior state/rollback history.
criteria.limitation: Automatic promotion is intentionally unsupported; end-to-end rollback of a deployed candidate is not demonstrated.

categories.name: Model/provider integration and independently verifiable specialist orchestration

criteria.description: Route local and explicitly authorized cloud models with tested capability/privacy boundaries.
criteria.limitation: Live provider availability is environment-dependent and was not established by this test run.

criteria.description: Use independent specialist components with explicit permissions and verification.
criteria.limitation: A specialist-agent orchestration system is not implemented.

criteria.description: Document authorization, ethical constraints, and low-cost human-reviewed experiment boundaries.
criteria.limitation: A persistent opportunity and experiment subsystem is not demonstrated.

criteria.description: Complete an authorized income experiment with independently verified revenue, cost, and net contribution.
criteria.limitation: No such experiment has been performed.

categories.name: Reliable long-running operation and resource management

criteria.description: Report runtime and provider health with resource-aware observations.
criteria.limitation: Health reporting is command-driven, not a supervised daemon.

criteria.description: Provide bounded persistent scheduling, restart recovery, graceful shutdown, and stalled-task detection.
criteria.limitation: A background scheduler/service lifecycle is not implemented.

categories.name: Testing, reproducibility, security, provenance, and operational auditability

criteria.description: Run deterministic local tests covering database, runtime, gateway, engineering, and benchmark behavior.
criteria.limitation: One environment's unit suite does not demonstrate all operating systems or real-provider behavior.

criteria.description: Enforce privacy, path/sandbox boundaries, and auditable provenance for consequential engineering operations.
criteria.limitation: Independent security assessment and full threat-model verification have not been performed.

calculation.rubric_weight_total_discrepancy: The directive states that the fixed category weights total 100, but the ten listed category weights sum to 95. All listed category weights and their criterion allocations are preserved; the percentage is normalized against 95 pending a versioned rubric correction.

blockers: Only the synthetic CPU benchmark is available; independent held-out generalization is unverified.
A live candidate-generation, evaluation, approval, and rollback path has not been demonstrated end to end.
Long-running service lifecycle and recovery are not implemented.
No verified ethical income experiment exists.
